cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - SlantedTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
One row tray with high back wall and low front wall
Can be used as a display or for cards or gaming tokens. Lay on the side to get piles to draw from. ![Example Use](static/samples/SlantedTray-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SlantedTray --sx 30:50:30 --y 70 --h 90 --front_height 0.5 --outside 1 --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes SlantedTray --sx --y --h --front_height --outside --thickness --burn --reference --labels
